## 2024-04-23 - Build Phase Skip via StatelessWidget Extraction
**Learning:** Found static widget trees being generated by large `_buildHelper` methods inside parent `build()` methods (like `_buildToolCard` and `_buildFileItem`). This forces the entire sub-tree to rebuild whenever the parent rebuilds. Attempting to isolate static state with `ValueNotifier` instead of using constants was an anti-pattern that broke data flow.
**Action:** Extract large static `_buildHelper` methods into dedicated `StatelessWidget` classes and instantiate them with `const` (where closures aren't passed) to safely skip the build phase for these sub-trees during parent rebuilds without trapping state or causing architectural regressions.
